1.Content: Is this your offering? Barely adequate.
Do not think this little offering will earn you my attention.
Your perseverance is admirable, at least.

2.Content: Pity. My standards are rather high.

1.Content: Hmm, your foolish persistence has successfully caught my attention.
Come, move closer. Let me get a proper look at you.

2.Content: You are trembling. Is it from fear, or... excitement?

1.Content: I must admit, you are slightly more pleasing to the eye than those fools.

2.Content: Easy. I will not bite... at least not yet.

1.Content: Do not get ahead of yourself. You are nothing more than my diversion.

2.Content: Why are you fifteen minutes late today? I expect a valid explanation.

1.Content: Look at me. Your eyes should reflect nothing but me.
Now that you have crossed into my land, your life belongs to me.

2.Content: As long as you behave yourself, I will give you everything you desire...

1.Content: Kneel, kiss the back of my hand, and swear your eternal loyalty to me.

2.Content: You smell so delicious... I am tempted to take a bite.

1.Content: Listen... that pounding heartbeat has completely revealed your submission.

2.Content: Naughty one... you will never leave me for the rest of your life.

1.Content: You are covered in my scent... you belong to no one but me now.

2.Content: Nestle in my embrace. Here, nothing can harm you.

1.Content: Throughout my endless immortality, you are the only variable that makes my existence less mundane.

2.Content: Be good, expose your neck... let me grant you my eternal love.

1.Content: Close your eyes, relax...

2.Content: Now, let me teach you what true pleasure really is...

1.Content: The test is over. You have won.

2.Content: Now... leave your mark on my body, one that belongs only to you.

1.Content: Draw nearer... Do not look away so soon.
Statues do not lie. They merely preserve one's final fear.
They call me a monster because they know no other name for what I am.
Beware. Even the brightest divinity cannot illuminate its own shadow.
Athena offers you order, is that so? I offer you the truth buried beneath its foundations.
Yet if you choose to lay the Sacred Flame at her feet... then surrender yourself to the serpent's gaze.
I hear the crackle of the Sacred Flame...
Do not let your eyes decide before your mind has weighed the cost.
A Sacred Pact, once forged, is not so easily broken.
The Sacred Flame may be offered to her... or to me. But choose wisely.
Medusa's gaze traps all life in place... but behind my shield, judgment marches on.
If you are merely seduced by the peril she exudes, remember: danger alone does not equal truth.
Hundreds of years and at last, here you stand.

2.Content: I was never far. Only a sea of clouds stood between us.

1.Content: Mortal, the Sacred Flame you dedicated to me has parted the mists of time.

2.Content: And as the Flame burns brighter, the past refuses to stay dead.

1.Content: Now that you have seen me, why do you still keep your distance?

2.Content: Because if I drew any closer, the weight of the past would only grow heavier.

1.Content: That temple... you rebuilt it exactly as it was.

2.Content: Every pillar stands just as I remembered.

1.Content: These halls once carried the fragrance of olive branches. Now, only the stench of the sea remains.

2.Content: That day... the rising flood changed everything.

1.Content: When the tide withdrew, I alone remained in the temple.

2.Content: I heard the silence that day. It was clearer than any prayer.

1.Content: I once believed that the curse was only your punishment.

2.Content: I will not deny the pain it brought you.

1.Content: It was meant to make those who sought to harm you fear your gaze... yet it condemned you to a life of solitude.

2.Content: What a touching story. But you were the one who left me with no one.

1.Content: After all these years, have you ever truly heard my name, even once?

2.Content: Every time I did, it was in the silence I never dared to break.

1.Content: Every statue my gaze left behind once called itself a hero.

2.Content: The songs of heroes rarely speak of those they drove to despair.

1.Content: I did not rebuild this ruined temple to worship you.

2.Content: I know. That was the judgment you left for me.

1.Content: The meaning of judgment was never yours to bear alone.

2.Content: Then here I stand... waiting for you to decide its weight.

1.Content: The old Sacred Pact... is breaking.

2.Content: This time, it will not be bound by divine laws, but by the choices we make.

1.Content: If I press on... will you still side with Olympus?

2.Content: No. This time, I stand where my guilt demands.

1.Content: The wind is rising. Which path shall we take this time?

2.Content: The one we were never meant to take.
